CREATE SCHEMASTORE VIEW v_au_condiments_20001_night1027c7 WITH CONTAINER psig AS
SELECT 'AU' AS country, 'condiments' AS concept, '20001' AS category_code, 'Food and non-alcoholic beverages' AS category_label,
       'M' AS frequency, period,
       ROUND(100.0 * (idx / LAG(idx, 12) OVER (ORDER BY period) - 1), 2) AS yoy_pct,
       'abs:CPI:1.20001.10.50.M' AS source_id
FROM (
  SELECT period_label.id AS period, CAST(obs_value[0] AS DOUBLE) AS idx
  FROM psig_abs.abs_au_cpi_20001_m_night1027c7
  LATERAL VIEW posexplode(data.structures[0].dimensions.observation[0].values) AS obs_position, period_label
  LATERAL VIEW explode(from_json(to_json(data.dataSets[0].series.`0:0:0:0:0`.observations), 'map<string,array<double>>')) AS obs_key, obs_value
  WHERE CAST(obs_key AS INT) = obs_position
) s
